title: Harden OpenCode config deadline and rejection notices
outcome: Fix the acknowledged OpenCode config apply path so it cannot report wholesale failure after state has already committed at the execution deadline, and bound JSON-RPC rejection details before persisting reset notices. Add deterministic regression coverage for post-commit deadline handling and oversized rejection messages.
acceptance: Acknowledged committed config updates return success even if the execution deadline passes immediately afterward; no new stage begins after deadline; persisted dependent-reset notices cap untrusted JSON-RPC error detail; focused regressions cover both behaviors; relevant quality gates pass.
